rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=214, train_n=0, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=140, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=tv_iterative iter-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). BASE_ITER=4 (the BEST, hr 0.208547: clip 0.08, lambda 0.001, lr 0.01). ONE KNOB: tv_iterations 160->140. The four live knobs in tv_reconstruction are tv_lambda/tv_iterations/tv_lr/tv_clip_max; GD step schedule is step=lr/(1+0.01*it) hard-coded. LEVER MAP at the budget-safe 120 iters: clip exhausted at top-of-bound [0.03,0.08] (iter-2 0.05->0.08 lifted hr 0.133->0.205, the lever); lambda BRACKETED at optimum 0.001 -- up@0.003 regressed (iter-3 0.1366), down@0.0005 regressed (iter-6 0.1582); lr BRACKETED -- up-2x@0.02 OVERSHOT (iter-5 0.1873), up-1.3x@0.013 FLAT (iter-7 0.2082); iters-UP@160 gave the PEAK hr 0.2085 + lowest RMSE 7.825e-4 (CONVERGENCE helps) BUT measured 1227.4s, breaching the HARD 1200s wall (metric-invalid). KEY EVIDENCE: iter-4 proves the data term is mildly UNDER-converged at 120 iters (more steps -> lower RMSE -> higher hr), but buying that convergence via 160 iters breaches budget, via 2x lr overshoots, via 1.3x lr lands flat at 0.2082. The GENUINELY-UNTRIED band is tv_iterations between the budget-proven 120 and the over-budget 160 -- none probed. iter-4 showed the 120->160 ramp is monotone in RMSE/hr. HYPOTHESIS: 140 iters (~2/3 through that proven ramp) converges the data term further than the 120-iter base toward iter-4 lower residual (RMSE toward 7.825e-4), lifting hr toward/above the 160-iter peak 0.208547 -- at a WALL-SAFE cost. PREDICTED iter-8 hr ~0.2085. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.208547 (no gain), the convergence gain saturates by 140 iters and cannot be bought within the HARD 1200s budget -- 0.2085 hr / ~0.927 SSIM is the STRUCTURAL classical-TV FBP-ceiling on dense (2304-view) real Mayo LDCT, and ALL FOUR live levers are exhausted (clip top-of-bound, lambda bracketed, lr bracketed, iters budget-capped); STOP tuning tv_iterative. BUDGET: cost model from real iter-2 (928s@120) + iter-4 (1227s@160) pairs gives c_step=7.48 s/TV-iter, overhead=30s; n=140 -> T=30+140*7.48=1077s = 90 pct of the 1200s wall (~123s margin); at +10 pct GPU-contention variance (c_step 8.23) -> 1182s, STILL under the wall. n=150 REJECTED (~1152s nominal but ~1267s @+10 pct variance, breaches); n=160 REJECTED (iter-4 already measured 1227s, over). val = ALL 214 L277 slices unchanged. sbatch --time=00:30:00 SLURM safety net above the 20-min metric-validity budget.
